newsitem.title: FRANCE: Jospin wants policies which careful on spending.
newsitem.headline: Jospin wants policies which careful on spending.

text.p: French Socialist leader Lionel Jospin said on Sunday that France must seek bold economic policies which were nonetheless careful on public spending.

"I propose to (French people) a pact...for a change in policies, economic policies which are audacious but careful on public spending," he said after the first round of France's parliamentary election which showed the combined left ahead of the ruling centre-right RPR/UDF coalition.

French and European markets were expected to weaken on Monday on worries a Socialist victory in the second round of voting next Sunday would produce a government less committed to any austerity need to make France ready for monetary union.

The Socialist party has said it supports the launch of a single currency in 1999, but is not prepared to impose a new round of austerity just to bring the public deficit down to precisely 3.0 percent of gross domestic product.
Jospin's comments were broadcast on French television.
